priceSnapshot.note: Up 1.10 percent on the 24h open of 78,303.6, but that headline hides the session. Against the 80,726.8 the midnight session read six hours and forty-six minutes ago BTC is DOWN 1,565.6 points, or 1.94 percent. The reversal was sharp and it began almost exactly when midnight published: the 07:00Z hourly bar opened 80,571.7, printed 80,812.1, then collapsed 1,451.9 points to 79,360.2 and settled at 79,704.4. The 09:00Z bar extended the low to 78,880.0. The three bars since have held a 615.2 point band between 78,880.0 and 79,495.0, so the flush has stopped without a reclaim.

reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE below $78,880.0 AND a failure to reclaim it on either of the next two hourly bars. That is the exact session low, printed on the 09:00Z bar, and the floor of the three-hour base that has formed since. Spot is 281.2 points above it, which is 0.40 hourly ATRs at the current 705.89 - deliberately tight, because the 8.45m long-liquidation stack sitting at 78,750, 78,500 and 78,250 begins 130 points beneath that line and 6.31m of it is LONG liquidations. Losing the base feeds directly into that stack. The two-bar reclaim clause is retained: this desk has logged six occasions where a gate set inside a live range was wicked rather than confirmed.

addIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE above $79,999.8 - a straight reclaim of the exact level whose loss triggered this session's reduce. Spot is 838.6 points below it. That handle rejected price twice on 2026-08-24, became the breakout floor overnight, and then broke on three consecutive settled closes this morning. Taking it back on a close would mean the morning flush was the liquidity grab rather than the overnight impulse, and the trim gets re-deployed.

decisionBox.changed: Position flips from ADD to REDUCE, and like midnight's flip the reason is mechanical rather than discretionary: midnight's own reduce gate FIRED, cleanly and in full. Midnight wrote 'a settled 1H CLOSE below $79,999.8 AND a failure to reclaim it on either of the next two hourly bars'. The 07:00Z bar closed 79,704.4 - the first settled close below. The next two bars closed 79,928.9 and 79,193.6. Neither reclaimed. Every clause of the gate is satisfied. Midnight's add gate at a settled close above 81,280.0 never came close; the session high since publication is 80,812.1. Midnight's 78,717.2 invalidation has NOT been breached - the 78,880.0 low missed it by 162.8 points - which is precisely why this is a REDUCE and not an EXIT.

liquidityMagnet.note: Pull is DOWN, and this is a genuine reversal of midnight's read rather than a re-weighting of the same evidence. Proximity is near-symmetric - 79,250 sits 88.8 points above, 79,000 sits 161.2 below - but the mass behind each is not. Above spot the next three buckets to 80,000 hold 6.42m and are short-tilted, meaning upside fuel. Below spot the 78,750 / 78,500 / 78,250 shelf holds 8.45m of which 6.31m, or 75 percent, is LONG liquidations sitting in a tight 500 point band. That is a trapdoor, not a cushion. The 24-hour composition confirms the shift: 14.94m of long liquidations against 16.50m of short, a 1.10-to-1 ratio that has collapsed from the 2.23-to-1 SHORT tilt midnight measured six hours ago. The forced selling has caught up with the forced buying.

Against the 2026-08-21 08:00Z anchor the divergence stands - price made a high 1,764.3 points above it while the histogram fell 941.28 points - and, crucially, it is now RE-WIDENING rather than decaying. Midnight measured the live leg at -43.32 and argued the tape was invalidating the signal; the per-bar sequence since reads -111.94, -108.47, -155.63 and -194.05 on the live 12:00Z bar. It repaired for exactly one bar and then rolled over, and the 81,280.0 high has not been challenged since. This desk called that one wrong six hours ago and the correction is recorded here rather than buried: the divergence resolved DOWN, and it is now weighted as a live bearish signal rather than a decaying artefact.

calibration.rollingRecord: Across the last eight graded sessions the desk is 2 marginal wins, 5 losses and 1 unresolved. The morning result forces an honest amendment to the finding the last four reports have repeated. That finding was 'every loss in this record is a trim taken into strength that the tape immediately ran through', and midnight acted on it by buying 20 USDT at 80,726.8 instead of trimming. Six hours later that add is 1,565.6 points - 1.94 percent - underwater. The finding was too narrow. The real pattern is that this desk acts on extremes in BOTH directions too early: it trimmed into strength four times and got run over, then bought into a 1,439.8 point vertical with a daily RSI of 87.62 and got run over the other way. The common error is not the direction, it is entering at the extreme of a move rather than waiting for it to be worked off. The one clean winner in the window remains the 2026-08-24 midnight seeder's 15 USDT spot buy at 78,847.4, which was taken into WEAKNESS near support - the opposite of both failure modes.
calibration.note: Graded against midnight's own two gates. REDUCE at a settled 1H close below 79,999.8 with no reclaim on either of the next two bars: FIRED IN FULL. The 07:00Z bar closed 79,704.4 after collapsing from a 80,812.1 high; 08:00Z closed 79,928.9 and 09:00Z closed 79,193.6, so neither reclaim bar closed above the line. ADD at a settled 1H close above 81,280.0: did NOT fire, and was never threatened - the highest print since publication is 80,812.1, 467.9 points short. Midnight's 78,717.2 invalidation was NOT breached; the 78,880.0 session low missed it by 162.8 points, which is the entire reason this session reduces rather than exits. actingHelped is FALSE: midnight's ADD is 1.94 percent underwater and the reduce gate it wrote as protection is the one that paid.
